mapper.sql: l.line_id, l.order_id, o.order_no, l.line_no, o.cust_id, o.cust_po_no, l.item_id, i.item_cd, i.item_nm, i.unit_cd, l.due_date, l.qty, l.shipped_qty, l.status, l.done_by_ship_yn
mapper.select: select from sal_order_line l join sal_order o on o.order_id = l.order_id join mst_item i on i.item_id = l.item_id where o.cust_id = #{custId} and l.status = 'OPEN' order by l.due_date, o.order_no, l.line_no
select from sal_order_line l join sal_order o on o.order_id = l.order_id join mst_item i on i.item_id = l.item_id where l.line_id in #{id} order by l.line_id

select from sal_order_line l join sal_order o on o.order_id = l.order_id join mst_item i on i.item_id = l.item_id where l.status = 'OPEN' and l.due_date <= #{dueTo} and l.item_id in #{id} order by l.item_id, l.due_date, l.line_id
